ambiguities.text: retrieve_column_sidecars is implementation and context dependent
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementations may use any combination of local storage, P2P requests, and DAS sampling to retrieve column sidecars. The specification intentionally leaves this flexible.

ambiguities.text: If not [data available], this payload MAY be queued and subsequently considered when blob data becomes available
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the MAY means implementations should queue blocks when data is unavailable rather than rejecting them permanently. This is the recommended but not mandatory behavior.

implicit_assumptions.description: Sufficient network peers custody enough columns to allow any node to reconstruct data availability within the MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS window
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Nodes could permanently fail to verify data availability for valid blocks, causing them to be stuck or fork from the canonical chain

implicit_assumptions.description: The KZG commitment scheme used for column sidecar verification is cryptographically sound
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: An attacker could forge valid-looking column sidecars for unavailable data, breaking the data availability guarantee

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot selectively withhold specific columns while making others available in a way that prevents reconstruction
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Data withholding attacks could prevent honest nodes from verifying data availability while appearing to serve data
